description: The Claude browser extension is collected as kind=ext and matched by id.
why: Verifies the ext route end to end: a real signed artifact, a real profile, and an identifier osquery derives from the manifest key rather than one we assert. The same method works on any Chromium browser -- osquery's chrome_extensions spans 11 browser_types and a Chromium extension id is key-derived, so it is identical in Brave, Edge and Chromium. The extension is then registered by Chrome for Testing's --load-extension, not from the store, so the row carries sideloaded:<sha256 of manifest.json>. The hash changes with every release, so the assertion pins the token beside <all_urls>, which the provenance CASE cannot produce for an unreferenced row.
known_gaps: Chrome for Testing registers the extension, because branded Chrome 137 and later refuse --load-extension. Branded Chrome's own install, update and ExtensionInstallForcelist paths are untested, and whether the policy needs an MDM-delivered profile on macOS is UNVERIFIED.
